name: InitBitReader
evidence: sets the bit reader up over a ring buffer (DemultiplexPacks calls it)

name: PeekBits
evidence: returns the next bits of the bit reader's window without consuming them

name: AdvanceBits
evidence: consumes bits, refilling the 64-bit window a byte at a time and wrapping at the buffer's end

name: ReadBits
evidence: returns the next n bits and consumes them

name: ReadBit
evidence: returns the next bit and consumes it

name: SkipBytes
evidence: consumes a number of whole bytes

name: GetPositionAhead
evidence: returns the buffer position a number of bits ahead of the reader
